row: Dr. Mansum: Vet Tips for Pet Parents

Follow for weekly vet tips for cat and dog parents!

Bio: Dr. Mansum Yau is a Vancouver 🇨🇦veterinarian, canine massage therapist, stand-up comedian, public speaker, author, and illustrator of “The Ins & Outs of Cat Carriers: A Veterinarian's Guide to Cat Carriers”. Available on Amazon, Kindle, Kobo, Google Play, and Apple Books almost worldwide!
